name: SVC_COLLAB_RESOURCES
description: This table is used to store collaboration users and channels.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: ALTERNATE_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Indicates the team alternative identifier for collab channel. Example: Microsoft Teams identifier for a group of channels.

columns.name: COLLAB_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of this resource in the native system. Example: slack user or channel identifier.

columns.name: COLLAB_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the resource name as shown on the native collaboration channel. Example: slack user or channel name.

columns.name: DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the user display name in the native system. Example: slack user or channel display name.

columns.name: TEAM_ID
columns.description: Indicates the workspace identifier of this user in the native system. Example: slack team identifier.

columns.name: IMAGE_URL
columns.description: URL in the native system to an image of the user.

columns.name: COLLAB_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Indicates the teamid of the user or the channel in the native system.

columns.name: COLLAB_GROUP_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the team name of the user or the channel in the native system.

columns.name: RESOURCE_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Indicate whether this record represents  users, channel or private channel.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
